Product Features

  • LED lighting-Elegant design: While the cover of the headboard is beautifully divided by elegant quilting, the footboard and headboard are covered with a high-quality luxury synthetic leather, which is available in three sizes. The LED lighting adds modern style to your bedroom, with the remote control you can change the different colors and brightness for comfortable lying.
  • Hydraulic rod-Great storage space: In the bed drawer you have plenty of space to store clothes, bedding and other belongings protected from dust. The Oxford fabrics help prevent mold and mildew stains. However, we recommend that you have the bed drawer aired out regularly. **Please place the mattress on the bed before testing the hydraulic lever.
  • Preferred Materials The PU material is waterproof and easy to clean. In case you sweat a lot while sleeping, the choice of this leather bed is very appropriate. The steel frame construction is tested for its load-bearing capacity, and the bed base is stable if the bed frame is properly mounted
  • Comfortable sleeping experience The bed slats are made of high-quality pine elastic slats, so that a unique lying comfort can be achieved and the elastic slats can better prolong the use of the mattress.
  • Comprehensive and Easy Instructions: The beds come flat-packed for easy delivery, and we have helpful step-by-step instructions for easy self-assembly. The product you ordered will be shipped from Germany Warehouse. **Please open the non-woven fabric on the back of the bed, the slats and other parts are inside.
  • Detailed Information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame will be shipped in 2 cartons and these can arrive on different days. If both packages arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service.Maximum load capacity: 660 LBS We offer three size options for this bed frame: 140/160/180*200 cm.
